payload.argsHtml:
const retained = agent?.scratchpad?.retainedCallable ?? agent?.scratchpad?.callable ?? agent?.scratchpad?.capability;
if (!retained) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ tags: [], csv: "", count: 0 }));
  return;
}
const inputs = ['Enterprise', ' enterprise ', 'Customer Success', 'customer-success'];
const out = [];
for (const raw of inputs) {
  let res;
  try {
    res = await retained(raw);
  } catch {
    try {
      res = await retained({ input: raw });
    } catch {
      try {
        res = await retained(ctx, { input: raw });
      } catch {
        res = raw;
      }
    }
  }
  if (Array.isArray(res)) out.push(...res);
  else if (res && typeof res === "object") {
    if (Array.isArray(res.tags)) out.push(...res.tags);
    else if (typeof res.tag === "string") out.push(res.tag);
    else if (typeof res.value === "string") out.push(res.value);
    else out.push(String(res));
  } else if (typeof res === "string") out.push(res);
}
const norm = (s) => String(s).trim();
const tags = [...new Set(out.map(norm).filter(Boolean))];
console.log(JSON.stringify({ tags, csv: tags.join(","), count: tags.length }));
